question: What makes shadcn/ui different from libraries like MUI or Chakra UI?
options: It only works with class components
Its CLI copies component source code into your project, so you own and edit it
It ships a runtime CSS-in-JS engine
It renders components on a canvas
explanation: shadcn/ui is open code: `npx shadcn add button` writes the component into your repo. It is built on headless primitives and Tailwind.

question: What does a headless component library provide?
options: Behavior and accessibility (focus, keyboard, ARIA) without any styles
Server-only components without JavaScript
A complete Material Design theme
Icons and fonts
explanation: Radix Primitives, Base UI, React Aria and Headless UI handle state, keyboard interaction and ARIA. You provide every visual decision.

question: How do headless primitives usually expose their state for styling?
options: Through inline styles they inject
Through `data-*` attributes such as `data-state="open"` that CSS or Tailwind variants can target
Through global CSS classes like `.is-open`
They do not expose state
explanation: Attributes such as `data-state`, `data-open` or `data-disabled` let you write `data-[state=open]:rotate-180` or `[data-open] { ... }`.

question: Which primitive layer do new shadcn/ui projects use by default since July 2026?
options: Radix Primitives
Base UI
React Aria Components
Headless UI
explanation: shadcn/ui switched its default to Base UI. Radix is still fully supported with `shadcn init -b radix`, and existing projects do not need to migrate.

question: Your team needs a branded design system with strict accessibility. Which approach fits best?
options: Write every dropdown and dialog from scratch with divs
Combine two styled kits to get more components
Use headless primitives (or shadcn/ui on top of them) and apply your own styles
Override the internal class names of a styled kit with deep selectors
explanation: Headless primitives give you tested accessibility while leaving the brand entirely in your hands. Deep overrides and hand-rolled widgets are fragile.
